definition: The American artificial intelligence (AI) organization OpenAI has released a variety of products and applications since its founding in 2015..
details: The American artificial intelligence (AI) organization OpenAI has released a variety of products and applications since its founding in 2015.
story: Imagine a sketch artist who starts with static and, stroke by stroke, sharpens it into a face. The result feels creative because it is memory, reshuffled at speed. Given a starting line, the machine imagines what comes next — a word, a note, a patch of a picture. The model dreams a little, then cleans up the dream. That next-word, next-stroke magic is Products and applications of OpenAI.
